theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_pfi_imrep_orient_along_piece
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (F : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal) (m : ℝ), IsOpen U → LipschitzWith L F → MeasurableSet B → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ B, ∀ a' ∈ B, m * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖F a - F a'‖) → (∀ a ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ F a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ F a)) → F '' B ⊆ R.carrier → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun b => R.orient (F b)) (volume.restrict B) ∧ ∀ᵐ b ∂(volume.restrict B), IsUnitOrientationOf (R.orient (F b)) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ F b : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))
